title: Grand Theft Auto VI generates 3.79 billion dollars in first-day retail sales
seoTitle: Grand Theft Auto VI first-day sales record
dek: Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto VI achieved 3.79 billion dollars in retail sales during its first day of release. The company stated this figure represents the largest entertainment launch in history.
happened: On 19 November 2026, the video game Grand Theft Auto VI was released globally. According to developer Rockstar Games, the title generated an estimated 3.79 billion dollars in retail sales within its first 24 hours. The company reported that 32.5 million units were sold through pre-orders prior to the launch. Rockstar Games president and founder Sam Houser described the release as the beginning of a new chapter for the studio. The game, which is set in the fictional state of Leonida, received a score of 99 on the review aggregator Metacritic. The day-one sales figure exceeds the total worldwide box office earnings of the film Avengers: Endgame, according to media analytics firm Rentrak. Following the release, various police departments in the United States issued public statements advising citizens not to replicate the criminal activities depicted in the game. The American Psychological Association noted that there is insufficient scientific evidence to support a causal link between violent video games and real-world violent behavior.

sides.says: The company announced the game generated 3.79 billion dollars in retail sales on its first day. President Sam Houser stated, "We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world, and we couldn't be more excited to share this moment with you."

sides.who: Police departments in the United States
sides.says: Authorities issued warnings to the public to avoid re-enacting criminal behavior from the game. The Atlanta police department stated, "GTA is not a real place, but Atlanta is! Don't confuse virtual entertainment with real-life decisions."

next: Investors are awaiting further information from Take-Two Interactive regarding a potential PC version of the game and the rollout of an online multiplayer component.
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI set a record for the largest entertainment launch in history by generating 3.79 billion dollars in retail sales on its first day. Developer Rockstar Games confirmed 32.5 million units were sold via pre-orders. The game, which features an open-world setting inspired by Florida, received critical acclaim with a 99 Metacritic score. While the launch was celebrated by fans, some United States police departments issued reminders for players to distinguish between the game's virtual criminal activities and real-life conduct.
